newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Gilts to slip lower, supported at 112-15.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Gilts to slip lower, supported at 112-15.

text.p: June gilt futures on LIFFE look set to continue Wednesday's decline on Thursday but should find support around 112-15, technical analysts said.
"There is a potential breach of yesterday's low on the cards, with initial support coming in at 112-15," said Lynn Branigan, technical analyst at MCM Yieldwatch here.
He said 112-05 was an intraday support level and the market was likely to find near-term support around previous intraday highs and lows on the downside.
By 0725 GMT, June gilts were 4/32 lower at 112-26.
Branigan placed an initial upside block around 113-05, but said any retracement beyond there was likely to be kept within the 113-09,10 area.
This area is a 62 percent retracement of Wednesday's slide from 113-23 to 112-20.

"All immediate levels are previous highs and lows. There's nothing too significant at the moment because a couple of weeks back we had a strong rally so it's all intraday levels on the downside," he said.
June gilts have rallied sharply from May 6 to as high as high as 114-24.
Elizabeth Miller, technical analyst at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell in London said she expected to see an immediate short-term bounce in gilts, with a retreat to around 112-14 later on.
She placed intial support at Wednesday's low of 112-20, with any rebound being capped by a chart congestion area at 113-07.
"We think 113-07 will hold and provide a cap for the day and we look for a retreat targeting 112-14 and 112-07, both of which are retracement levels," Miller said.
By 0808 GMT, September short sterling was unchanged at 93.18.
